messages.content: 我想在聖荷西附近的Walmart買蘋果、米飯和12罐瓶裝水。請顯示產品資訊和庫存情況。

function.name: walmart_purchase
function.description: Retrieve information of items from Walmart including stock availability. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

product_list.description: Items to be purchased listed in an array.

pack_size.description: Size of the product pack if applicable. The size of the array should be equal to product_list. Default is not use it if not specified.

message.reasoning: The user wants to buy apples, rice, and 12 cans of bottled water at a Walmart near San Jose. They want product info and inventory status. We need to call the function walmart_purchase with location "San Jose" or "nearby" and product_list ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"] and pack_size [12] for bottled water? Actually pack_size array should match product_list length. For apples and rice, no pack_size needed. But we can provide pack_size [12] for bottled water only? The array length should equal product_list length. So we need pack_size array of length 3. For apples and rice, we can set pack_size null or 0? The spec says default is not use it if not specified. So we can omit pack_size entirely. But we need to specify pack_size? The function signature: pack_size?: number[]. So optional. So we can omit pack_size. But we need to specify product_list. So we call function with loc: "San Jose" and product_list: ["apples", "rice", "bottled water"]. That should return product info and inventory status.
